start: Welcome to Bitstreamer! As our new central processor, you'll be running all the programs around here. I'm sure you'll make a fine replacement, so let's get started!
Programs send us data in the form of {perfect_click_color}bits[/color]. It is your job to receive them when they arrive at your blinking cursor.
To receive a zero bit, press {zero_bit_keybind}.
To receive a one bit, press {one_bit_keybind}.
Try not to miss any bits or receive them incorrectly. Now, give it a go!
enter_bit: Huh, uh, you that Daniel gentleman?
